content: In reply to https://hacdias.com/articles/2020/05/back-90s/. Love the animated GIFs! The background! One thing: my feed reader has a hard time handling the relative image URLs in your RSS … (Hint: https://validator.w3.org/feed/docs/warning/ContainsRelRef.html. [I only know about this link because I ran into the same thing —different blog, though—earlier this week.]) (Also, I couldn’t help but notice that RSS items lack the “context” that makes replies and such so much more understandable. Not a huge issue, just thought I’d let you know.)
